summary_en: MP-2606 K.K., a special purpose vehicle wholly owned by MBK Partners funds, announced a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of SHARINGTECHNOLOGY INC. (TSE Growth: 3989) and all warrants, aiming at complete acquisition. The bidder has secured a commitment from the largest shareholder Asset Value Investors Limited to tender 7,078,700 shares (28.08%).
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for All Shares of SHARINGTECHNOLOGY INC. (Securities Code: 3989) by MP-2606 K.K.
translation_en_brief:
MP-2606 K.K. announced the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of SHARINGTECHNOLOGY INC. (TSE Growth: 3989) and all warrant instruments. MP-2606 K.K. is a special purpose vehicle established on June 11, 2026, and is wholly owned by MBK Partners' funds—MBK Partners JC V, L.P. (Cayman) and Hippo Finance Limited (Asia). MBK Partners is an independent private equity firm focused on investments in East Asia (Japan, China, and South Korea), with approximately 33 billion USD under management as of the announcement date. The firm has completed 84 investment transactions across East Asia since its establishment in March 2005, with 22 investments (17 companies) in Japan, including Yayoi K.K., U.S.J., Invoice Inc., Komeda Co., Ltd., TASAKI Inc., and others.

The acquirer secured a commitment from Asset Value Investors Limited (AVI), the target's largest shareholder, to tender all shares owned by AVI Japan Opportunity Trust Plc and AVI Japanese Special Situations Fund, totaling 7,078,700 shares representing 28.08% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares), subject to certain exceptions. As of the announcement date, neither MBK Partners, its funds, nor MP-2606 K.K. held any shares or warrants of the target.

The transaction is structured as part of a broader acquisition plan to achieve complete ownership of SHARINGTECHNOLOGY INC., with the full tender offer seeking all ordinary shares (including those to be issued upon warrant exercise, but excluding treasury shares held by the target) and all warrants.
